jobs.title: Innovation Engineer – Software & Applications
jobs.description:
Location:
Shannon, Co. Clare, Ireland
Reports To:
CTO
Job Type:
Full-Time, Permanent, Onsite

The Opportunity

Ei Electronics is a top three global brand in smoke and carbon monoxide sensing with a growing base of connected products and environmental sensing technology.
We are now asking ourselves what the next generation of life-safety technology will look like and investing deeply in frontier innovation. We want to explore that question by building, experimenting and turning new ideas into working technology.
We are looking for an ambitious and curious Applications Engineer to join our new Global Innovation Centre in Shannon. This is not a conventional software development role focused on maintaining existing applications or delivering incremental changes. It is an opportunity to work at the very early stages of innovation — exploring emerging technologies, developing prototypes and creating new digital capabilities that could shape the future of technology within the home.
You could be building a backend to collect data from a new sensor one week, developing a dashboard to turn that data into useful insights the next, and experimenting with AI, cloud technologies or a completely new user-facing application after that.
Some ideas will develop into future Ei products and services. Others may prove that a particular technology or approach doesn't work. Both are part of innovation.
We are looking for someone who enjoys building software, experimenting with technology and turning data and ideas into something people can actually use. The effective use of modern AI development tools will be a core part of this role, enabling ideas to be developed, tested and demonstrated much faster than through conventional development approaches.
What You'll Do

You will work within Ei's Innovation Centre on early-stage connected technologies and concepts, taking ideas from initial investigation through to functional prototypes and proof-of-concept systems.
Your work will include:
Exploring emerging software, IoT and connected technologies that could create new opportunities in life safety, sensing and the connected home.
Developing backend services and systems to collect, process, store and analyse data from products, sensors and connected devices.
Designing APIs and interfaces between connected products, cloud services and user-facing applications.
Developing intuitive dashboards, web applications and mobile experiences that turn product and sensor data into useful information and insights.
Using modern AI development tools extensively to accelerate software development, coding, testing, debugging and rapid prototyping.
Experimenting with cloud platforms, databases, data analytics, AI and machine learning.
Building customer facing rapid proof-of-concept systems to determine whether new ideas are technically viable and valuable.
Working with electronics, embedded and RF engineers to connect physical prototypes with digital platforms and applications.
Developing new technical concepts and contributing to the creation of new intellectual property and patents.
Collaborating with universities, technology partners and researchers and helping successful concepts progress towards future product development.

Who We're Looking For

We're more interested in curiosity, technical ability and ambition than finding someone who has already done exactly this job before.
You should be the kind of engineer or developer who wants to understand how things work, enjoys experimenting and is prepared to build something to test an idea rather than simply discuss whether it might work.
You will ideally have:
A degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Electronic & Computer Engineering or a related technical discipline.
Strong software development and programming skills.
Strong practical experience using modern AI development tools to accelerate application development.
An understanding of backend development, databases, APIs and modern application architectures.
Knowledge of cloud technologies and connected-product architectures.
An appreciation of UI/UX and the ability to make complex information simple and intuitive for users.
An understanding of cybersecurity and data protection principles for connected products.
Strong analytical and problem-solving ability, with the confidence to investigate unfamiliar technologies and learn quickly.

Useful Experience

You don't need to have everything on this list. Experience or an interest in any of the following would be useful:
Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, C#, Java or similar languages
Backend and full-stack development
SQL and NoSQL databases
REST APIs, WebSockets, MQTT and other IoT interfaces
Modern web frameworks such as React, Angular or Vue
Mobile application development for iOS or Android
Dashboard development, data visualisation and UI/UX
AWS, Azure, GCP or similar cloud platforms
IoT technologies including Wi-Fi, Bluetooth/BLE, Matter, Thread and LoRa/LoRaWAN
Data analytics, machine learning and AI
Cybersecurity for connected products
Rapid prototyping and taking a digital concept from initial idea to working demonstration

Experience

We are open to engineers and developers at different stages of their careers.
You may be a recent graduate with excellent technical ability and a portfolio of applications, projects or systems you've built yourself, or you may already have several years of industry experience and want the opportunity to move into a more exploratory and innovation-focused environment.
Above all, we are looking for someone who is technically curious, creative, ambitious and excited by the opportunity to create something that doesn't exist yet.
Why Join Ei's Innovation Centre?

Ei Electronics develops l technology used in homes around the world. Our Innovation Centre has been established to look beyond today's products and investigate the technologies and ideas that could define what comes next.
You'll have access to modern R&D laboratories, engineering equipment, connected-product technologies and the resources needed to turn ideas into real working prototypes.
Most importantly, you'll have the opportunity to work on problems where the answer isn't already known.
We offer a competitive salary and bonus scheme, health benefits, professional development opportunities and the opportunity to help create technologies that could ultimately improve and protect people's lives.

jobs.title: Solutions Engineer
jobs.description:
About Oliasoft:

Oliasoft develops cloud-native engineering software for designing, planning and constructing wells for oil and gas, carbon capture and storage (CCS) and geothermal energy.

Our first product, Oliasoft WellDesign, was launched in 2020. By automating time-consuming work processes and combining AI with advanced, physics-based simulations in areas such as thermodynamics and fluid mechanics, we make well planning more efficient and more accurate.

Following several commercial and technological breakthroughs, we are now entering a new phase of growth. Interest in our solutions is strong, with customers such as Equinor, Vår Energi, Harbour, and Tullow, and we are expanding the platform to serve a growing international customer base. That's why we're building the team that will take Oliasoft to the next level.

Who we are:

The team consists of highly skilled employees with knowledge from software development, math, physics and the oil and gas industry. The common denominator is a passion for innovation and a desire to deliver high quality products.

Our work environment is characterized by dedicated professionals, cooperation, curiosity and discussions related to providing value to our customers. We are constantly evolving through challenging work tasks and are given great freedom in how we want to solve them.

Our Customer Success department is responsible for ensuring that our customers achieve their desired outcomes with Oliasoft products. We work tightly with the Marketing, Sales and Product teams to provide insights from our customers to the rest of the organisation. We are now looking for a Solutions Engineer for our Oslo team. The Solutions Engineer combines well engineering domain expertise with strong technical aptitude to support customers across the full lifecycle of the Oliasoft WellDesign platform. We provide comprehensive training in the platform, enabling you to manage everything from technical evaluation during the sales process through onboarding, training, and ongoing technical support that drives adoption, retention and expansion. The position reports to the Head of Customer Success in Oslo and involves approximately 20–30% travel to customer sites, workshops and industry conferences.

As a Solutions Engineer at Oliasoft you will:

Present live WellDesign demonstrations – from consultative sessions with individual engineers to VP-level technical evaluations – translating platform capabilities into concrete engineering value

Partner with Sales to run technical discovery calls, proof-of-concept and pilot engagements with prospective customers

Represent Oliasoft at industry conferences and technical workshops, presenting to broader technical audiences

Translate customer well engineering requirements and workflows into effective WellDesign configurations and technical solutions

Respond to technical sections of RFPs and RFIs, and lead technical workshops with prospect engineering teams

Contribute to onboarding and training for new customers, ensuring continuity from evaluation through to daily use

Deliver technical support to customers using our established support systems

Support renewal conversations with technical evidence of the value delivered

Contribute to best-practice guides, training and sales enablement material

To succeed in this role you should have:

Confidence in holding presentations, demonstrations and customer workshops, for both technical and commercial audiences

Solid grounding in well engineering fundamentals: casing design, drilling mechanics, trajectory design

Relevant work experience from Oil & Gas, for example Drilling Engineering, Well Planning, Completion Engineering or oilfield technical software (design, application engineering or field engineering)

Bachelors or Masters degree in a relevant engineering discipline (petroleum, drilling, mechanical or chemical), or equivalent practical experience

Excellent interpersonal and collaboration skills, and the ability to communicate with engineers and commercial stakeholders alike

The ability to keep calm when working under pressure and deliver on promise

The ability to communicate fluently in English, both written and verbal

Willingness to travel regionally and internationally

A valid work permit for Norway

Previous experience in pre-sales or technical support, fluency in additional European languages, and knowledge of Oliasoft WellDesign and Forecast are advantages, but not requirements, for the position.

What we offer:

The opportunity to participate in one of the most interesting Norwegian software companies creating revolutionary software for the oil industry

Highly proactive and creative colleagues that are passionate about technology, programming and engineering, wanting to build the best product possible

Opportunity to make a difference – both for the industry but also in the company

Minimal bureaucracy and leadership levels, so that we can make fast decisions and be customer oriented

Small team - possibility to really make an impact and with good opportunity to further develop your skills

Open, friendly, diverse and relaxed working environment

Competitive compensation and flexible workhours

Apply now and before 23 October!

For more information contact Julie on
julie.jacobsen@oliasoft.com

Etsimme suomen ja englannin kielen taitoisia Azure-kehittäjiä erityisesti finanssisektorin asiakasprojekteihimme. jobs.description:
Senior Technical Solutions Engineer(Contractor)

This role is a contract assignment at Palo Alto Networks. Contractors will not be employed by Palo Alto Networks but through our trusted staffing partners.

Role Description

● This role is a 12 months contract assignment at Palo Alto Networks.
● Location: Singapore(3x office)
● The ideal candidate will have valid work authorization to work within Singapore.
This position is not eligible for any visa sponsorship.

About Palo Alto Networks

At Palo Alto Networks, everything starts and ends with our mission: Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.
We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we are looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.

Your Career

You will work firsthand with our valued customers to address their complex post-sales concerns where analysis of situations or data requires an in-depth evaluation of many factors. As a critical thinker, you understand the methods, techniques, and evaluation criteria needed to obtain high-quality results. You enjoy networking with key contacts outside your own area of expertise, with a strong capability of detailing difficult technical issues to both non-technical and technical professionals.
You will regularly participate in technical discussions with multi-functional teams, creating an environment of transparency that ultimately leads to better products, better working environments, and better cybersecurity. Your quick thinking and support to our clients provides the fast assistance they need to keep their environments secure—which means you will move quickly, thoughtfully, and provide technical assistance as needed (often in high-pressure situations).

Your Impact

Palo Alto Networks is looking for a Senior Technical Solutions Engineer
to provide premier, high-end support for our enterprise customers. In this role, you will deliver expedited response times and serve as a trusted technical advisor within a dedicated team of experts.

Key Responsibilities

Customer Support & Technical Services:
Provide advanced technical support, guidance, and troubleshooting to enterprise customers and partners. Perform root cause analysis, and recommend operational best practices.
Case Management:
End-to-end management of support cases to ensure issues are accurately recorded, tracked, prioritized, resolved, and followed up on in a timely manner.
Diagnostics & Fault Isolation:
Perform deep-dive fault isolation, log analysis, and root cause analysis for complex, multi-layered technical issues.
Knowledge Sharing & Documentation:
Author and publish Technical Support Bulletins, articles, and troubleshooting documentation in the internal and external Knowledge Base.
Technical Content Review:
Review technical documentation for training materials, manuals, and diagnostic guides.
On-Call Availability:
Provide on-call technical support during weekends and public holidays on an as-needed basis.

Qualifications & Experience

Technical Proficiency

Experience:
5+ years of technical support or customer facing experience in enterprise environments.
OS & Application Debugging:
Demonstrated expertise in troubleshooting, installing, and debugging applications across Windows, Linux, macOS, and Android OS platforms.
Microsoft Ecosystem:
Strong working experience with Microsoft technologies, including Active Directory (AD), Group Policy (GPO), Exchange, System Center Configuration Manager (SCCM), MS SQL Server, and IIS.
Endpoint & Network Security:
Hands-on experience with endpoint security software (Antivirus, Data Loss Prevention [DLP], Intrusion Prevention Systems [IPS], and Network Access Control [NAC]).
Security Technologies:
Experience with advanced security infrastructure, including EDR, SOAR, SIEM, IPsec, SSL-VPN, NAT
Cloud & Virtualization:
Foundational knowledge of public cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, GCP) and Virtual Desktop Infrastructure (VDI) environments (VMware, Citrix).
Scripting & Automation:
Proficiency in Bash or Python scripting for task automation, log parsing, and technical analysis.
Complex Environments:

Language Skills

English:

Preferred Languages:

or Korean
is highly preferred (a valuable asset, but not mandatory).
